name: bollinger_squeeze_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: Bollinger Band width on 1-min bars contracting to its 120-bar minimum signals a volatility squeeze — a coiled spring of compressed price action that tends to release in a directional breakout. On NIFTY 50 stocks, intraday squeezes often occur during the 11:00-13:30 lunch lull, and the subsequent breakout at 13:30-14:00 as institutional desks return is tradeable. The inefficiency exists because most squeeze indicators are calibrated for daily charts; on 1-min bars, the squeeze-and-release cycle happens 2-3 times per session but is invisible to daily-timeframe traders. The breakout direction can be predicted by the Keltner Channel: if BBands compress inside Keltner, the squeeze is on; breakout direction follows the preceding EMA slope.
mechanism: Bollinger band extremes indicate price has moved beyond 2 standard deviations from its recent mean. This typically results from a liquidity-driven overshoot rather than fundamental revaluation. Market makers and statistical arbitrageurs recognize the overshoot and trade against it, while the original directional flow exhausts, creating a natural mean-reversion within 30-90 seconds.

conditions: squeeze_on has been True for >= 10 bars (genuine compression, not momentary)
mom_slope > 0 (momentum oscillator turning up — likely upside breakout)
squeeze_on has been True for >= 10 bars
mom_slope < 0 (momentum oscillator turning down — likely downside breakout)

exit.signal_exit: if BB_width contracts again (squeeze reforms) while in trade, exit (false breakout)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 12 and 20 (too low = no breakout energy; too high = noise)

weaknesses: False breakouts are common on 1-min timeframe — the squeeze releases but price reverses within 5-10 bars, triggering the stop loss. Expected ~45% of signals are false breakouts.
The momentum oscillator direction is not a reliable predictor of breakout direction on 1-min bars; random price fluctuations in the squeeze zone can flip mom_slope frequently
During lunch hours (11:30-13:30) when squeezes commonly form, volume is low, making breakout confirmation via volume unreliable
prior_art: Bollinger (2001) Bollinger on Bollinger Bands; Carter (2012) TTM Squeeze (Keltner inside Bollinger). Adapted for 1-min Indian equity intraday context.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
